chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Hasan from 'Ula' ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'Until when does the pilgrim have the Umrah?' He said, 'Until the dawn of the Night of Arafah.'
ai.seo_question: When does the time for performing Umrah during Hajj end?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the temporal boundary for performing Umrah al-Mufradah when combined with Hajj, specifying that the validity extends until the dawn of the 18th of Dhu al-Hijjah (Night of Arafah). This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence for distinguishing between the Hajj Tamattu' and Qiran forms, ensuring pilgrims understand the precise window to complete the Umrah rites before the Hajj rituals commence. It reflects the detailed legal precision characteristic of the Imams in regulating the Hajj calendar.
